name: Kolkata Chana chur
ingredients_raw: Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil and/or Cottonseed Oil), Peanuts (7%), Gram Flour, Refined Wheat Flour, Dew Beans Flour (Moth Flour), Split Chickpea (7%), Whole Chickpea (6%), Corn Flakes (2%), Rice Flakes (2%), Split Green Gram (2%), Whole Lentils (2%), Cashew (1%), Raisins (1%), Potato Sticks (1%), Flattened Chickpeas (Chana Press) (1%), Green Chilli Flakes (0.5%), Almonds (0.5%), Green Peas (0.5%), Dehydrated Potato Flakes, Starch, Ground Spices & Condiments (Dried Cucumber Seed, Sesame Seeds, Sugar, Iodised Salt, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Red Chilli, Coriander, Turmeric (Coloring and Spices), Cumin, Ginger, Black Pepper, Fennel Seeds, Curry Leaves, Bishop’s Seed, Cardamom, Clove, Nutmeg, Asafoetida, Pomegranate Seeds), Spinach Powder, Baking Soda
